theorem_title: Small-denominator perturbations preserve the unconditional harmonic denominator rate
formal_statement:
theorem ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonic_perturbed_log_den_rate (s : ℕ) (hs : 0 < s) (r : ℕ → ℚ)
    (hr : Tendsto (fun N => logDen (r N) / (N : ℝ)) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => logDen (harmonicPower s N + r N) / (N : ℝ))
      atTop (nhds (s : ℝ)):= by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every fixed positive natural order $s$ and every rational sequence $r_N$ such that $\log\operatorname{den}(r_N)/N\to0$, one has $\log\operatorname{den}(H_N^{(s)}+r_N)/N\to s$. The perturbation is arbitrary subject to its stated sublinear logarithmic denominator condition. The harmonic baseline and prime-number-theorem inputs are proved; they are not extra hypotheses.
